newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Intel unit to invest $500 mln in Philippine plant.
newsitem.headline: Intel unit to invest $500 mln in Philippine plant.

text.p: A unit of Intel Corp is planning to invest an additional $500 million over the next three years in its assembly plant in an industrial park south of Manila, a company official said on Wednesday.
Intel Philippines Manufacturing Inc president Jacob Pena Jr told reporters the company is planning to invest in state-of-the-art equipment and facilities and increase the plant's production capacity.
So far, the company has already invested $400 million in the microprocessor plant.
Details of the expansion plan were not disclosed.
The company will start commercial operation of its assembly plant within the first quarter of the year, the official said.
